Introduction

AtHeart is a girl group under TITAN CONTENT, they debuted on August 13, 2025 with the EP Plot Twist. Their name combines “Heart” with “At” and the “@” symbol, symbolizing global connection and emotional bond with fans.

The group was first announced on July 16, 2024, with members Sorin and Michi introduced as part of a “NEXT-GENERATION K-pop strategy.” Three more members—Seohyeon, Katelyn, and Aurora—were revealed in November 2024.

In February 2025, Sorin left the group, and Nahyun, Arin, and Bome joined, finalizing the lineup at seven members. On February 21, their official social media accounts and a debut teaser were released.
Ahead of their debut, AtHeart dropped a pre-debut single, “GoodGirl AtHeart,” on March 14, 2025.
